item.title: Peter Jackson to Receive 2026 Cannes Film Festival Honorary Palme d’Or
item.description: The "Lord of the Rings" filmmaker joins the company of Agnès Varda, Marco Bellocchio, Jodie Foster, Meryl Streep, Robert De Niro, and more.

item.title: ‘I Swear’ Trailer: John Davidson’s True Life Story Is Finally Coming to America
item.description: The Tourette syndrome campaigner at the center of the BAFTA Film Awards' recent debacle is also the subject of a new biopic, soon to arrive on domestic shores.

item.title: ‘Rooster’ Review: Steve Carell’s Charming HBO Comedy Just Needs to Get Out of Its Own Way
item.description: Bill Lawrence and Matt Tarses' new sitcom follows a popular author who lands a job at a college where his daughter teaches in the hopes of helping her through a bad break-up.

item.title: ‘Industry’ Creators Considered Jennifer Jason Leigh for Harper’s Mom but Decided to Never Show That Character At All
item.description: Creators Mickey Down and Konrad Kay tell IndieWire why they relied on Myha'la’s performance to capture the power Harper’s mother had over her character.

item.title: ‘Vladimir’ Review: Rachel Weisz’s Vexing Netflix Series Aims for ‘Fleabag’ and Falls Wildly Short
item.description: Adapted from Julia May Jonas' novel of the same name (and adapted by the author herself), the eight-part limited series follows a literary professor whose fixation on a hot young author takes over her life.

item.title: 2026 Oscars Presenters Include Robert Downey Jr. and Gwyneth Paltrow
item.description: The Academy has also tapped all four of last year's Oscar-winning actors, plus stars like Chris Evans, Chase Infiniti, Paul Mescal, and Demi Moore to present at the 2026 Academy Awards.

item.title: Los Angeles Festival of Movies Announces 2026 Lineup Led by ‘Maddie’s Secret’ and ‘Blue Heron’
item.description: The festival will return to venues around Los Angeles from April 9-12.

item.title: Why Concert Films Like ‘Stray Kids’ and ‘EPiC’ Are Hot Tickets at the Box Office
item.description: While generally the bread and butter for event cinema releasing distributors, players like Bleecker Street, Neon, Paramount, and Netflix are all playing the event cinema game.

item.title: Hollywood Honored Two Producers Last Weekend. Only One Represents Its Future.
item.description: The PGAs honored Jason Blum and Amy Pascal, two producers who couldn't be more different. Together they map the shrinking middle ground of American moviemaking.

item.title: The Stars of ‘Deli Boys’ Explain the Different Types of Excitement They Felt Before Filming Seasons 1 and 2
item.description: Poorna Jagannathan, Asif Ali, and Saagar Shaikh joined IndieWire and Lavazza for a Coffee Break on the blue carpet.
